terms.definition_en: Linguistic meaning: exerting utmost effort and power in terms of speech or deeds. Terminological meaning: fighting carried out by a Muslim against a belligerent disbeliever.
terms.review_note: The page's English fields are swapped; both meanings are shown, each verbatim, labelled by us. The Arabic explanation on the page is broader (struggle against the self and Satan); reviewer to decide.

terms.definition_en: Singling Allah out in everything exclusive to Him: His Lordship, His divinity (worship), and His names and attributes; and dissociating oneself from polytheism and its people.
terms.review_note: Heading set from the hackathon reference package (p. 7, term dictionary samples) on 5 October 2026; the encyclopedia's own English title is 'Monotheism'. Definition and link unchanged (verbatim from the encyclopedia).

terms.definition_en: The clear course in the religion that includes the beliefs, rulings, and ethics.
terms.review_note: Heading set from the hackathon reference package (p. 7, term dictionary samples) on 5 October 2026; the encyclopedia's own English title is 'Islamic law'. Definition and link unchanged (verbatim from the encyclopedia).

terms.term_en: Fatwa (religious ruling by a qualified scholar)

terms.definition_en: A large group of people who share one religion, common beliefs or practices.

terms.definition_en: Everything that is definitively prohibited under Shariah.
Giving out a specific part of certain kinds of property in a certain manner to certain types of people.
Guiding to belief in Allah Almighty and what was brought by His messengers, and to believing in what they said and obeying of their commands.

terms.definition_en: What is reported to us from the Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) including his statements, deeds, affirmations, traits, or behavior, before or after the Prophetic mission.
A set of statements and actions that starts with Takbīr and ends with Taslīm.
